visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera pans across the interior of a floating library, showing rows of light-wood bookshelves filled with colorful books. A diverse crowd of people, including adults in jackets and children, browse the aisles. The lighting is bright and industrial, emanating from a high white ceiling. (2) A transition shows the view through a large window of the ship. Outside, several gray naval-style ships are docked in Keelung Port under a cloudy sky. In the foreground, multiple navy blue caps with a white "Doulos Hope" logo sit neatly on a white surface. (3) The scene shifts back inside to the book section labeled "Christian Living". People walk through the open space, some carrying umbrellas, while others flip through books. The floor is a solid, warm peach color, and the environment feels bustling yet organized. (4) A low-angle exterior shot captures the massive white hull of the ship against a pale sky. The Republic of China flag flies prominently from a white mast. Below, people are seen walking along a gangplank connecting the ship to the pier at the harbor. (5) In the final phase, the camera focuses on the "Children's books" section. A young man sits on the floor near a plastic bin, while families explore the low shelves. Yellow and blue signage provides directions, and the overall atmosphere is one of curious exploration.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 這是世界上最大的海上圖書館. (2) [Subtitle]: 目前在基隆港停靠. (3) [Subtitle]: 這艘漂浮的圖書館，承載著2000多本各種主題的書籍. (4) [Subtitle]: 由於這是台灣第一次有船隻載著各種語言寫成的佳作書籍抵達基隆港. (5) [Subtitle]: 因此也被學者們稱為『台灣第一家言書基』. (6) [Logo]: @Doulos Hope. (7) [Slogan]: Bestsellers. [Slogan]: Christian Living. [Slogan]: Children's books. [Slogan]: Welcome to Doulos Hope.
